test_title: PYST 54: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: After deleting a file from a folder, a user realises that it was an important file. Which of the following steps should they follow to restore it?

options.text: Press Ctrl + Z repeatedly until it reappears
Restart the computer and the file will return
Open Recycle Bin → Right-click the file → Click Restore
Use Alt + Tab to recover the file

solution:
The correct answer is __**Open Recycle Bin → Right-click the file → Click Restore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• When a file is deleted in Windows, it is typically moved to the Recycle Bin, making it recoverable unless it has been permanently deleted (e.g., using Shift + Delete).
 
• The Recycle Bin acts as a temporary storage area for deleted files and allows users to restore them to their original location.
 
• T
